$comment: One entry per example directory. The tests read it against the directories; the deploy workflow deploys each entry with `deploy`, passing `release` when there is one, and then fetches `check.path` until the page carries `check.contains`. Change an example and its entry together.

examples.name: paper-lark
examples.title: A static site
examples.stack: HTML and CSS, no build step

examples.name: sunny-tern
examples.title: A single-page app
examples.stack: Vite and React, built on your machine

examples.name: crimson-finch
examples.title: A Node.js server with a Dockerfile
examples.stack: Node.js, no dependencies, its own Dockerfile

examples.name: misty-heron
examples.title: An Express server
examples.stack: Node.js and Express, built on Tori without a Dockerfile

examples.name: amber-ibis

examples.name: mossy-starling

npx tori.host env list    # again, until DATABASE_URL is listed
